title:
Punggol was
*once a ghost town*

lines.say: You are a buyer in 2012. Punggol has an MRT, rows of new flats, and not much else. Friends ask why you'd live so far.
lines.cap: you are a buyer in 2012. Punggol has an MRT, new flats, *and not much else*

lines.say: The plan was announced in 1996. Then the Asian financial crisis hit, and building slowed for years.
lines.cap: the plan was announced in 1996. then the *Asian financial crisis* slowed it for years

lines.say: Stage one. The MRT opened in 2003. Flats came first. Shops came much later.
lines.cap: stage 1: *the MRT opened in 2003*. flats first, shops much later

lines.say: Stage two. The waterway opened in 2011. A year later, an EC launched in Punggol at around seven hundred dollars psf.
lines.cap: stage 2: the waterway opened in 2011. a 2012 EC launched at *around $700 psf*

lines.say: Stage three. Waterway Point opened in 2016. A second MRT and the Digital District followed in 2024.
lines.cap: stage 3: Waterway Point in 2016. *a second MRT and the Digital District in 2024*

lines.say: Today, that 2012 EC trades around fifteen hundred psf. Roughly double.
lines.cap: today that EC trades *around $1,500 psf*. roughly double

lines.say: A later EC in 2019 started at about one thousand and eighty dollars psf. By then, the plan was already priced in.
lines.cap: a 2019 EC started at about $1,080 psf. *the plan was already priced in*

lines.say: The biggest gains usually go to buyers who enter when the plan is visible, but the amenities aren't built yet. That's stage two.
lines.cap: biggest gains usually go to buyers who enter at *stage 2*: plan visible, amenities not built yet

lines.say: Which township do you think is at stage two today? Comment below.
lines.cap: which township is at stage 2 today? *comment below*

source: Roots.gov.sg · HDB · CDL · Stacked (12 mth avg) · Twin Waterfalls launch ~$7xx psf
caption:
Punggol was once called a ghost town. 🏝️

An EC launched there in 2012 at around $700 psf. Today it trades around $1,500 psf. A later EC in 2019 started at $1,080 psf, because by then the plan was priced in.
